color.note: Calm, bank-like neutrals with one action blue. Three people-colors (joint, member A, member B) are the only other hues; they always travel with a name label.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background behind cards and lists.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, list groups, the bottom tab bar, bottom sheets.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Input fields, segmented-control track, empty progress track, calendar day cells.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between list rows and card sections. Decorative only, never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of controls that need a visible edge (unchecked checkbox, outlined button). 3:1 on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken in both themes (light darkened 2026-09-29).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and expense amounts, on every surface token and every -soft tint.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: dates, memo, card names, captions. On surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one action color: primary buttons, the add button, selected tab, links, and income amounts. As text on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and primary-soft.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Selected calendar day, active menu item, tinted info banners. Text on it is primary or ink. Dark brightened 2026-09-29 so selection is visible against surface-raised (1.4:1).

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Label and icon on a primary fill. Never hard-code white.

tokens.name: joint
tokens.usage: 공동 (shared) spending: its chip text, dot, and its segment in split bars. As text on surfaces and joint-soft.

tokens.name: joint-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the 공동 chip.

tokens.name: member-a
tokens.usage: Person A: name chip text, dot, avatar ring, their segment in split bars. As text on surfaces and member-a-soft.

tokens.name: member-a-soft
tokens.usage: Background of person A's chip.

tokens.name: member-b
tokens.usage: Person B: name chip text, dot, avatar ring, their segment in split bars. As text on surfaces and member-b-soft.

tokens.name: member-b-soft
tokens.usage: Background of person B's chip.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Over budget, destructive actions (삭제), form errors. Always paired with words such as 초과 or 삭제, never color alone. As text on surfaces and danger-soft.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the over-budget badge and error banners.

tokens.name: online
tokens.usage: Realtime connection status dot only (sidebar avatar). Never for money or people. Always with a hidden text label; offline is a hollow ring, not a color change.

tokens.name: income
tokens.usage: Income amounts (+1,200,000원). Alias of primary, the Korean banking convention of blue for money coming in.

tokens.name: expense
tokens.usage: Expense amounts (−293,252원) everywhere: lists, home, calendar, stats. Red for money going out, blue (income) for money coming in. Separate from danger, which stays for over-budget and delete warnings.

tokens.name: holiday
tokens.usage: Public holidays: date numbers on the schedule calendar and holiday names in lists (F-55). Same hue as danger but a separate meaning; never for warnings. Always paired with the holiday name in text, never color alone.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind sheets, side panels, the phone menu and modal dialogs. Always darkens the page in both themes (never use ink with opacity: ink is light in dark mode).

families.sans: "Pretendard", "IBM Plex Sans KR", -apple-system, "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif

groups.name: Numbers
groups.note: Every amount uses tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums) so columns of 원 line up.

styles.name: amount-hero
styles.usage: The one headline figure per screen: this month's spending on 홈, net worth on 자산.

styles.name: amount
styles.usage: Amounts in transaction rows and summary cards.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen titles and the month switcher.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Merchant names, form fields, most text.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Dates, card names, helper text, in ink-muted.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, chip padding (vertical).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between a label and its value, chip padding (horizontal).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between related rows inside a card.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Transaction row vertical padding, gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter and card inner padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections on a screen.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Above the hero amount; bottom sheet top padding.

radius.note: Softly rounded, like a banking app; pills only for chips and the add button.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, segmented-control segments, calendar cells.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards and list groups, buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Top corners of bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Chips, dots, avatars, the round add button, progress bars.

shadow.note: Cards sit flat on surface with no shadow; only floating things lift.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: The add button and the tab bar.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets (입력, 편집).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control: a 2px gap, then a solid 2px primary ring (box-shadow, so it follows the radius).
